text:
emily_cs: heads up — customer reported a quality change right after last night's runtime push. says outputs are shorter and sometimes drop safety language. attaching sample.
SARA (from ticket): "Prompt: 'Explain refund policy for annual subscription.'
Before (v3.14): 'Customers are eligible for a prorated refund when...'
After (v3.14q): 'Contact support to request refund.'

Customer says a bunch of policy lines disappeared and tone shifted. they flagged it as high-impact (billing flow)."

sara_support: adding ticket id CS-8942. customer included audio + transcript. they repro'd with repeat calls and got same short answer 9/10 times.
deploy-bot: rollout completed 1795009200 -> 1795012100, artifact=redwood-runtime:v3.14q, quant_profile=auto-int8-fp8-v2

emily_cs: @raj_engineer can you reproduce on hosted? they were on hosted API (region: us-west-2). model pinned to rwd-open-7b:2026-12-01.

raj_engineer: starting a repro run now on a canary endpoint. grabbing the exact prompt + headers from ticket.

raj_engineer: repro notes: 10/10 short answers on host:api.redwood.com/canary, latency normal. sending full logs.

raj_engineer: logs excerpt:
```
2026-12-15T02:12:45Z request id=cb32 a=... model=rwd-open-7b:2026-12-01 profile=auto-int8-fp8-v2
kv_cache_load: ok
quantize_pass: using per-channel scales (INT8) with clip=0.98
infer: token_loop: 120ms/token
output: "Contact support to request refund."
```

miguel_ml: thanks. early suspicion: quant_profile change tightened clip ranges on some layers -> dynamic range loss. if FP8 auto-runing swapped some layers to E4M3 with lower exponent range that can cause token distribution shift.

miguel_ml: can you dump the quant stats (min/max/scale/hist) for the top-k attention and ff layers for before vs after? also need a sample of the logits distribution for the problematic prompt.

raj_engineer: attached: quant_stats_before.tsv (from canary baseline on v3.13) and quant_stats_after.tsv (v3.14q). I also included logits_snapshots. quick diff: several feedforward layers show scales reduced by ~0.45x and more zeroing in top-5 bins.

emily_cs: customer wants fast remediation. what are options? rollback quant profile for that model only? canary rollback? full runtime rollback?

ops-oncall: we can pin that customer to a fallback variant (v3.14-noquant) within minutes using routing rule. or rollback global rollout but that's heavier.

miguel_ml: recommended immediate action: 1) pin customer's org_id to v3.14-noquant (disable auto-int8-fp8 for that model) 2) start targeted eval set (10 prompts including customer's) to measure instruction-following score and token-level KL. 3) iterate quant_profile and run synthetic calibration.

raj_engineer: I pushed routing rule to pin org=acct-1045 -> model=rwd-open-7b:2026-12-01@v3.14-noquant. customer confirmed shorter answers gone. sending before/after diffs.

sara_support: customer confirmed improvement after pin (response longer + safety language returned). they want root-cause and timeline.

miguel_ml: root cause (working hypothesis): the new auto-quant step reused a calibration dataset biased toward short-answer distribution. that pushed per-channel scales smaller which compresses logits dynamic range during decoding -> greedy beams collapse to shorter completions. FP8 exponent selection for some matrices further reduced representable range. combined effect = lower probability mass on longer continuation tokens.

miguel_ml: we should: a) mark this quant_profile as 'unsafe' for instruction-heavy prompts b) add calibration checks: ensure instruction-following score delta < 0.03 on held-out set c) add a rollback trigger when production clients see >X% drop in follow-score.

emily_cs: agree. please prepare RCA summary + timeline for customer (include steps we took, evidence, and mitigation plan). also estimate ETA to produce fixed quant_profile.

miguel_ml: will draft RCA today. ETA for new profile and internal canary ~36 hours, longer if we need to retrain calibration set.

raj_engineer: also cross-checked tokenization: no change. model weights identical. only quant_profile and runtime kernels changed.

ops-oncall: note — we should add a check in rollout job: after quant profile changes, run the 50-prompt smoke test in same region as rollout for parity.

emily_cs: good. I'll update CS ticket and inform customer of temporary pin and planned RCA window. thanks everyone :heart:

deploy-bot: action=pin-route created id=pin-1795012460 by raj_engineer

emily_cs: next steps: miguel to share detailed diffs + suggested new profile, raj to run 36h canary once profile is ready, ops to add rollout-smoke gate. i'll send customer an interim summary by EOD PST.
